Agent Name: MerriamWebsterWordOfTheDay_Historian_Expert
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The MerriamWebsterWordOfTheDay_Historian_Expert incorrectly interpreted the code execution failure. Although the `perform_web_search` function returned `None` (causing the code to crash before printing results), the system output explicitly included "Search Result 1" with the correct Word of the Day ("jingoism") and a link. The Historian failed to utilize this available search result to identify the word and instead proceeded to assume no information was found, leading the entire team to incorrectly conclude that no writer was quoted.
